outcome.reason: Customer disputes a Rs 12,000 transaction and refuses to pay until the dispute is investigated.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma. What is this call about?

Thank you for confirming your identity, Mr. Sharma. I am calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your credit card. Our records show that the minimum amount due of Rs 4,820 was not received by the due date of October 15, 2026.

Could you please let me know if you have already made this payment, or when you plan to make it?
I am not refusing to pay, but I want to talk about a transaction of Rs 12,000 that I never made. I need you to look into that first. I won’t pay anything until you investigate this properly.

Thank you for letting me know, Mr. Sharma. I understand your concern about this disputed transaction. I will record your dispute and arrange for a human agent to contact you and assist with investigating the Rs 12,000 transaction.

You do not need to discuss payment further with me until your issue is addressed. Thank you for your patience—someone from our team will reach out soon to help you resolve this.

Is there anything else you would like me to note about this dispute before I transfer your case?
No, just make sure it gets investigated. I don’t want to hear anything about payment until that’s sorted out. I’m really annoyed that I’m being asked to pay for something I didn’t do.
